PHOTO.supports: Visible west facade: brick ground row, five tan rows, two pale top rows, red six-level south end, paired four-pane windows, roof banks and pale membrane. Original joins private.

LASER.source: TxGIO Bexar and Travis Counties2021 building-class height-above-ground raster,0.5m; direct inward wall/roof-strip samples

INFER.supports: Unseen north/east elevations and northern roof equipment; complete bay count and lower obstructed openings; individual window widths/depths; upper0.65m parapet; material albedo; horizontal coordinate placement

SUPERSEDED.status: Superseded by direct laser sampling plus photographed two-level upper setback; old estimate retained here as conflicting evidence
